content: MDN and the CSS Color Adjustment specification document that forced-colors replaces author colors at paint time, suppresses image-backed effects such as box shadows, and exposes system colors including Canvas, CanvasText, ButtonFace, ButtonText, ButtonBorder, GrayText, Highlight, HighlightText, and LinkText. forced-color-adjust defaults to auto; none opts out and should be limited to cases necessary to support—not defeat—the user's contrast choices. Durable borders and geometry should replace color fills/shadows that may disappear.
